''See also: [[Jarelys Teach Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Jarelys [[Teach]] is a high-ranking military leader serving as the General of [[The Empire|the Empire]] and the Head of the [[Imperial Guard]]. She is characterized by her striking appearance, featuring close-shaved pale hair and piercing icy blue eyes. She typically wears red-and-black plate armor and carries a formidable [[sword]] named [[Tyrfang]] over her shoulder. As a pillar of [[Imperial]] strength, she commands respect and [[Authority|authority]], often leading squads of guards and maintaining a disciplined, intimidating presence that can make others feel as though they are facing an empress. Her physical capabilities and longevity are enhanced by having a [[Kameira]]'s heart—specifically that of a [[Bonereaver]]—integrated into her body, which provides her with increased endurance and strength. Despite these superhuman qualities, she can still be wounded in combat, such as during a battle with [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin Maze-walker]]. Following significant injuries, she has experienced periods of extreme exhaustion and a transformative coma that raised concerns regarding her mental stability and potential corruption by [[Kameira blood]]. Throughout various political and military conflicts, she has functioned as a key figure in The Empire{{!}}the Empire's defense, participating in strategic meetings and serving as a nominal leader for certain factions.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Jarelys [[Teach]] is clad in plate armor of red and black. She has undergone physical alterations, including a [[Kameira]] graft and the replacement of her heart with that of a [[Bonereaver]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a General and the Head of the [[Imperial Guard]], she holds significant [[Authority|authority]] and possesses the support of the Guild of Magisters{{!}}Magister's Guild. She is viewed as a threat by [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]], particularly because she killed his father and objects to him wearing the Emperor's crown.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Jarelys [[Teach]] is an adversary to [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]], having killed his father and posing a lethal threat to him and his crew. She is also an opponent of [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin Maze-walker]], with whom she has fought, and has earned the ire of [[Meia]]. Additionally, Jarelys [[Teach]] is connected to [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]] through her role in admitting her to the [[Imperial Guard]] and has physically touched [[Rojric|Rojric Marten]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|She wields a blade known as [[Tyrfang]] and possesses the ability to fly upon a [[Kameira]] bird. Additionally, she has integrated biological components into her body through various grafts.}}
